dedupe_keys.name: tibi calendriers des collectes de dechets

description: TIBI - calendriers des collectes de déchets is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by TIBI. Calendrier des collectes couvertes par l'Intercommunale Tibi en 2026 The 2 datasets in this record: Calendrier des collectes 2026; TIBI - Calendrier de collecte - 2025. Coverage: Hainaut (Wallonia). The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Administration et Services publics. Its keywords are dechets, charleroi, collectes, pmc, Verre, intercommunale. The portal shows 1,419 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
